newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest airport signs $103 mln loan for expansion.
newsitem.headline: Budapest airport signs $103 mln loan for expansion.

text.p: Hungary's airport authorities signed on Thursday a $103 million syndicated loan for the construction of a new terminal at Budapest's Ferihegy airport, Hungarian economic news service MTI-Econews reported.
The loan, involving 20 banks, is lead managed by Hungary's OTP and CIB Banks and the Royal Bank of Canada Europe Limited. The loan, guaranteed by the Hungarian state, has a maturity of 12 years.
The credit was granted to the Ferihegy Passenger Terminal Development and Utilisation Kft (FUF) and will be disbursed during the 18-month construction period starting next month.
The total cost of the project is $120 million with the remaining funds coming from FUF's registered capital.
FUF is owned 34 percent by the Airport Development Corporation of Canada and 66 percent by the Hungarian state-owned airport authority LRI.
